svg.title: 69% of the large ships that enter the Savannah River reach Garden City; on the Hudson and the Mississippi, fewer than 1 in 10 reach the head port

cc:Work.dc:title: 69% of the large ships that enter the Savannah River reach Garden City; on the Hudson and the Mississippi, fewer than 1 in 10 reach the head port
cc:Work.dc:description: Fifteen falling step lines, one per river or ship channel, of the share of entering large ships seen at or beyond each point against distance scaled to the head port; four are highlighted: Savannah ends near 0.7, Houston near 0.13, the Mississippi near 0.07, and the Hudson near 0.05.
